notes: Technical report on multimodal agent capability (coding, tool use, GUI, Claw frameworks). No safety section, no risk framework labels, no external safety testers, and no safety/alignment/jailbreak/bio/cyber eval numbers. The only safety-adjacent claim is perception-critic training to reduce hallucination (topic only; no measured rate). Skipped all capability benchmarks per pilot override: Design2Code, Flame-VLM-Code, Vision2Web, ImageMining, BrowseComp-VL, MMSearch, MMSearch-Plus, SimpleVQA, Facts, V*, OSWorld, AndroidWorld, WebVoyager, CC-Bench-V2 (CC-Backend/Frontend/RepoExploration), PinchBench, ClawEval, ZClawBench, plus RL delta numbers on RefCOCO, PointBench, MVBench, SUNRGBD, OCRBench, CharXiv, MMMU, MathVista, LogicVista. Figures 4–5 are chart-only capability results. Model parameter count and context window not stated.
